sous_titre: Croissance des ventes mondiales sur un an en 2025, par type de motorisation électrifiée

Hybrides légers.texte: Toyota's mild-hybrid lineup saw a dramatic rise, jumping 86.8 percent to 177,172 units.

Véhicules 100 % électriques.texte: Sales climbed 42.4 percent from 139,892 to 199,137 units.

Hybrides rechargeables.texte: Plug-in hybrid sales also moved upward, climbing 19.5 percent to 183,845 vehicles.

Hybrides classiques.texte: Traditional hybrids formed the bulk of that number, with 4.433 million units sold, a 7 percent increase.
